name: google-calendar-new-event
title: Calendar New Event
description: A form that adds an event to the user's Google Calendar: title, time, guests and an optional Google Meet link. Guests get no email unless the user asks for one.

actions.title: Create an event in a calendar
actions.reason: Adds the events you make here to your calendar.

usage: <GoogleCalendarNewEvent initial={{ start, end }} onCreated={() => setRefresh((n) => n + 1)} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />
